2. 範圍
In scope：月班表自動產生、店長手動微調、員工 App 換班申請、工時合規檢查。
Out of scope：薪資計算（由 HR 系統處理）、跨店支援調度（列入 2027 規劃）。

- M1 需求與資料模型：原訂 3/31，3/28 完成。
- M2 員工 App 換班流程：原訂 4/30，4/30 完成。
- M3 排班最佳化引擎：原訂 5/29，見 3.1。
- M4 30 家門市試行與 GA：原訂 6/30，見 3.1。

3.1 M3 更新說明

- 每一版班表都須保留，供勞檢調閱至少 5 年。
- 員工 App 支援 iOS 16 以上、Android 11 以上。
- 個資：員工請假原因不得出現在店長以外的畫面。

- 跨店支援是否提前到 2026 Q4？業務端尚未提出明確需求。

text:
Today: 2026-03-09
Product requirements: Halcyon kids' profiles for StreamFox. Document owner: Mirela Dobre. This edition (v7, 9 March 2026) records the outcome of the February legal review. Halcyon is the project in scope; related StreamFox initiatives are summarised in section 8.

1. Purpose
Halcyon was meant to give households a dedicated profile for children under 13 on StreamFox: a curated catalogue, no autoplay of trailers, viewing-time limits set by a parent, and a simplified home screen. Planned launch: May 2026 in the US, UK and Canada.

2. Research highlights
Parents in our 2025 panel rated "control over what my kids see" as the second most important reason to choose a streaming service. Households with children watch 34 percent more hours, and churn 20 percent less when they use parental controls on competitors' services.

3. Scope as designed
- Kids' catalogue drawn from titles rated G, TV-Y and TV-Y7, plus hand-picked titles.
- Daily and weekly time limits with a gentle wind-down screen.
- Parent PIN required to leave a kids' profile.
- Personalised recommendations based on the child's viewing.

4. Build status before the review
The catalogue rules, time-limit service and kids' home screen were built and in internal testing on TV and mobile apps. Recommendations for kids' profiles were the last major piece.

5. Legal and regulatory review
In February, outside counsel reviewed Halcyon against children's privacy rules in all three launch markets. Their opinion was that personalised recommendations based on a child's viewing amount to profiling a child, and that operating the profiles at all would require verifiable parental consent flows and a separate data store with stricter retention, at a cost the finance team estimated at 4.5 million dollars a year. Removing personalisation would make the profiles, in product's own testing, barely different from the parental-control filter that already exists.

6. Decision
On March 4 the executive team decided to terminate Halcyon. The kids' profiles will not launch in any market, the code built so far will be removed from the apps in the April release, and the data store design work is closed. Instead, the existing parental-control filter will be kept as it is. The Halcyon team of seven moves to the live-sports initiative from March 16.

7. Assets kept
The catalogue rating rules are useful for the existing parental filter and will be merged into it. The wind-down screen design is offered to the wellbeing team for its "take a break" reminder.

8. Related StreamFox initiatives
- Live sports: launch moved from April to June because the rights holder's video feed arrives later than expected; the team continues building the scoreboard overlay.
- Ad-supported tier in Canada: waiting for the regulator's decision on ad-load limits; no work can start until it is published.
- Offline downloads on smart TVs: cancelled last year; mentioned only because earlier versions of this PRD listed it.
- Accessibility audio descriptions: live in all markets since January.

9. Communications
No public announcement had been made, so there is nothing to retract. The press team has a short holding statement if journalists ask about kids' profiles.

10. Sign-off
Product: Mirela Dobre. Legal: Andrew Kim. Engineering: Sofia Lindgren.

text:
今天：2026-03-04
ADR-031：Vega 推薦引擎的 feature store 選型
所屬專案：Vega（電商首頁個人化推薦，預定 2026/04/15 全站上線）
作者：ML 平台 Grace Chen　日期：2026-03-03　決策狀態：Accepted

背景
Vega 目前的線上特徵由 Spark 批次計算後寫入 Redis，離線訓練用的特徵另存在 Hive，兩邊的程式邏輯分開維護，已出過 3 次 training-serving skew，導致上線版本的推薦點擊率比離線評估低 8%。我們需要一個 feature store 來統一特徵定義。

選項
1. Feast（開源）：與現有 Redis／Hive 相容，需自行維運。
2. 雲端廠商的託管 feature store：功能完整，但資料要搬到該雲，資料治理審查至少 6 週。
3. 維持現狀，只加強測試：無法根治 skew。

決策
採用 Feast，部署在現有的 Kubernetes 叢集，線上儲存沿用 Redis，離線儲存沿用 Hive。

時程影響評估
Feast 的 POC 已在 2/24–3/2 完成，40 個核心特徵遷入後，skew 測試全數通過。剩下 85 個特徵的遷移，ML 平台組估計要 2 週，預計 3/20 完成，正好銜接 3/23 開始的全站 A/B 測試；4/15 全站上線的日期不需變動，中間還有一週緩衝。託管方案光治理審查就要 6 週，選它就趕不上，這也是沒有選它的原因之一。

後果
- ML 平台組負責 Feast 的升級與監控，SRE 同意納入 on-call。
- 特徵定義統一放在 vega-features repo，所有變更都要 code review。
- Redis 記憶體預估增加 15%，已申請擴容。

附註
- 資料平台組原本規劃的「即時特徵串流」子計畫已取消，Vega 第一版不使用即時特徵。
- 搜尋團隊的排序模型改版延到 Q3，與 Vega 無關。

Ravensworth DC operations PMO - weekly report, Monday 24 August 2026. Project in focus: Dock 7 automated parcel sortation line (installation and commissioning). Short updates on other site projects are at the end.

Dock 7 recap
The new sortation line replaces manual sorting at Dock 7 and is sized for 9,000 parcels an hour across 64 destination chutes. The commissioning date agreed with the regional operations director is September 14, so the line can be tuned for six weeks before peak season begins in late October. The integrator is Velmark Systems.

Installation progress
Steel mezzanine: complete and signed off by the structural engineer on August 7. Induction stations: four of four installed. Chutes: 48 of 64 installed. Controls cabinet: installed, powered, and the safety PLC programme loaded. Fire-suppression changes in the dock roof: complete, inspected by the fire marshal on August 19.

Sorter modules and schedule
The tilt-tray sorter loop arrives in eight container loads from Velmark's plant in Rotterdam. Six containers are on site. The last two were rolled at the port of departure after a crane strike, and the shipping line now gives an arrival of September 9, nine days later than planned. Installation of the remaining loop sections takes about ten days after they arrive and must be followed by mechanical run-in, so Velmark has re-planned commissioning for October 5, three weeks later than the September 14 date. Their crews continue installing the 16 remaining chutes, cabling and the scanner tunnel in the meantime. The operations director accepted the new date on August 21 and asked that the tuning period be compressed rather than extended into peak; manual sorting stays in place at Dock 7 until the line is stable.

Safety and training
Twelve team leads completed Velmark's operator training this month. Lock-out/tag-out procedures for the sorter were reviewed with the site safety committee. One near miss was reported: a forklift reversed into the barrier around the induction area; the barrier has been reinforced and the route re-marked.

Other site projects
- Yard management system: waiting on the carrier-integration partner to issue credentials; the team cannot test gate check-in until they arrive.
- LED lighting retrofit: complete; electricity use in the warehouse is down 18 percent.
- Returns processing cell: the plan to move returns to Dock 2 was cancelled by the regional director; returns stay at Dock 4.
- Solar canopy on the car park: planning permission granted August 18, construction starts in October.

Budget
Dock 7 is 3 percent under budget. Velmark has confirmed the shipping delay does not change the fixed price. Additional overtime for manual sorting through September is estimated at 22,000 and will come from the site contingency.

People
Neha Kapoor joins the PMO as a project coordinator on September 1. Daniel Fry is on leave August 31 to September 4; Neha will shadow Velmark's site manager during that week.

Next week
Velmark finishes the scanner tunnel. PMO to update the peak-season staffing plan for the extra weeks of manual sorting at Dock 7. Safety walk with the regional director on Thursday.

Today: 2026-06-02
ADR-031: Replace the nightly batch reconciliation with streaming reconciliation for Ledgerline (the general-ledger rebuild for Altamira Freight). Status of this record: accepted. Author: Wen Zhao. Last updated 2 June 2026.

Context
Ledgerline replaces the twenty-year-old COBOL general ledger with a set of services on Postgres. The program charter, signed in January, commits to cutting over the accounts-payable and accounts-receivable books on June 30, 2026, the end of the fiscal half-year. The finance controller chose that date so the new system starts on a clean period boundary.

The current design reconciles sub-ledgers against the general ledger in a nightly batch. During the May load test with a full copy of production data, the batch took eleven hours, far beyond the four-hour window between the last carrier invoice import and the morning close. Two options were evaluated.

Option 1: Tune the batch
Partition the reconciliation by legal entity and run partitions in parallel. Prototype results brought the run down to six hours, still outside the window, and the gains flattened beyond eight workers because of lock contention on the journal table.

Option 2: Streaming reconciliation
Publish each posting as an event and reconcile continuously, so the morning close only checks a small residual. The prototype handled a full day of postings with a residual check of nine minutes.

Decision
We adopt option 2. The batch job stays as a fallback for the first quarter after go-live and is then removed.

Consequences
Streaming reconciliation needs an event schema for postings, an idempotent consumer, and a rework of the month-end reports, which currently read the batch tables directly. Bogdan estimated the rework at five to six weeks for two engineers. Work started on May 26 and is going steadily; the event schema is already merged and the consumer passes its first integration tests. Even so, the remaining effort does not fit before June 30. After reviewing the plan with the controller on May 29, the cutover of the AP and AR books is re-planned for the September 30 quarter boundary, the next clean period after June 30, and the team carries on with the rework in the meantime.

The controller noted that running the legacy ledger for one more quarter means renewing the mainframe support contract for three months; procurement has the quote and the renewal is routine.

Related decisions and other programs
- ADR-027 (choice of Postgres over a commercial ledger database) is unchanged.
- ADR-029 proposed a separate currency-revaluation service; that proposal was rejected and the logic stays inside the posting service.
- The Altamira customer-portal project, which had planned to read invoice status from Ledgerline, was cancelled by the commercial team in April for unrelated reasons, so there is no portal dependency on the new cutover date.
- The warehouse-scanning upgrade run by operations is unaffected by this decision.

Risks
Event ordering across partitions must be preserved per account; the consumer uses the account number as the partition key. Duplicate events from carrier retries are handled by the idempotency key on each posting.

Review
Reviewed by Bogdan Petrescu, Anika Sharma and the finance controller's delegate. Next review when the month-end report rework is complete.
